title: Source and evidence
meaning: Keep source bytes identity, derived-text identity, exact quotation and interpretation activity separate. Reported PDF hashes are not fresh verification.

title: Document structure and versions
status: Exact retained-text IR implemented; full PDF layout not reconstructed
meaning: Retain text lines and page markers with offsets. A document is not a meeting, and a draft resolution is not an adopted act.

title: Government, public body and capacity
status: Candidate profiles and qualified contexts implemented
meaning: Separate municipality, board, membership, service district, geographic overlap and the capacity in which a board acts.

title: Meeting treatment and decisions
meaning: Track agenda matter, successive treatments, amendments, votes, proposed effects, actual recorded outcomes and time-sensitive attendance.

title: Money, projects and obligations
status: Selected cases and historical research rows mapped
meaning: Preserve ceilings, exclusions, conditions, cash timing, approval stages, bargaining units and funding sources. Do not infer execution or expenditure from authorization.

title: Claims, uncertainty and review
meaning: The source says X; an extractor interpreted Y; a reviewer checked Z. Keep these separate and preserve contradictory observations.

title: Questions, answers and crosswalks
meaning: Answers must state evidence, dates and unresolved facts. Mapping acceptance does not prove an answer is true.

title: Legal applicability overlay
status: Design overlay; no end-to-end legal conformance backtest
meaning: Bind a rule version to a jurisdiction, actor capacity, action type, effective period, conditions and exceptions. Do not apply current law retrospectively without checking.
